cardEffects:
[Trash] [Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into [Lucemon (X Antibody)], by returning this card to the bottom of the deck, your opponent may trash their top security card. If this effect didn't trash, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[Main] Delete your opponent's Digimon until they have as many as the number of your security cards. If this effect deleted, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
name: Seventh Divine Cruz
nameJapanese: セブンス・ディバイン・クルス

rulings.question: If my opponent doesn't trash a security card for this card's [Your Turn] effect, which player performs <Recovery +1 (Deck)>?

rulings.answer: Yes, you delete their Digimon until they have 0 left.
rulings.question: I have 0 security cards.  If I activate this card's [Main] effect, do I delete my opponent's Digimon until they have 0 Digimon?

rulings.answer: No, it isn't met.  The "if this effect deleted" condition is only met when a Digimon is deleted by this card's effect.  In this case, EX6-059 [Barbamon] wasn't deleted by this card's effect, therefore the "if this effect deleted" condition isn't met.
rulings.question: I tried to delete my opponent's EX6-059 [Barbamon] using this card's [Main] effect.  In response, my opponent uses ＜Scapegoat＞ on EX6-059 [Barbamon] to delete their other Digimon and prevent EX6-059 [Barbamon] from being deleted.  At such times, is this card's "if this effect deleted" condition met?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 [Lucemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
